create_strip_token_dataset: create a StripTokenDataset that wraps a dataset and strips a given token ID from sequence ends
use_strip_token_dataset_getitem: use StripTokenDataset __getitem__ to retrieve a sequence with leading and trailing tokens removed
review_strip_token_dataset_init: review the StripTokenDataset __init__ to understand how the wrapped dataset and id_to_strip are stored
test_strip_token_dataset: test the StripTokenDataset by wrapping a sample dataset and verifying tokens are stripped from both ends
build_strip_token_dataset_wrapper: build a dataset wrapper using StripTokenDataset to remove padding or special tokens from sequence boundaries
